title: AI原生企业如何将工作流转化为运营能力
summary: 本文探讨了AI原生公司（如Basis、Clay和Exa Labs）如何利用AI代理来优化关键业务流程，包括员工入职、客户账户管理和开发者集成。文章指出，这些公司通过将AI代理嵌入工作流中，不仅提高了效率，还将原本分散的流程转化为系统化的运营能力。对于企业领导者而言，文章提供了可借鉴的实践案例，强调了AI代理在自动化重复性任务、增强决策支持以及改善客户体验方面的潜力。文章还讨论了企业如何从传统工作流转向AI原生模式，以及在此过程中需要注意的挑战，如数据整合、模型可靠性和组织变革。总体而言，AI原生公司展示了将工作流转化为可持续竞争优势的路径，为其他企业提供了战略参考。
summary_en: This article explores how AI-native companies such as Basis, Clay, and Exa Labs leverage AI agents to optimize key business processes, including employee onboarding, customer account management, and developer integrations. It highlights that these companies not only improve efficiency by embedding AI agents into workflows but also transform fragmented processes into systematic operational capabilities. For enterprise leaders, the article offers practical case studies, emphasizing the potential of AI agents in automating repetitive tasks, enhancing decision support, and improving customer experience. It also discusses challenges in transitioning from traditional workflows to AI-native models, such as data integration, model reliability, and organizational change. Overall, AI-native companies demonstrate a path to turning workflows into sustainable competitive advantages, providing strategic references for other enterprises.
